trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied URL scheme in stored BBCode text (album description saved by db_input.php album_update) may become an <a href> when rendered; decided only at render time in check_link_type_and_replace(), with no scheme allowlist at the pinned commit (intake only applies htmlspecialchars).

landing_point.why: Advisory names db_input.php's album update endpoint; the description is read there with getEscaped and stored, but the HTML (href) is built later by bb_decode in include/functions.inc.php.
